items.exampleEn: I have a small confession to make: I forgot to water your plants.
items.exampleZh: 我得跟你坦白一件小事：我忘了幫你的植物澆水。

items.exampleEn: In the old story, a farmer tricks the devil and keeps his land.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一位農夫騙過了魔鬼，保住了他的土地。

items.exampleEn: The company betrayed its customers by selling their personal information.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司出賣了顧客，把他們的個人資料賣掉了。

items.exampleEn: Her eyes were full of compassion when she heard the sad news.
items.exampleZh: 聽到那個令人難過的消息時，她的眼神充滿同情。

items.exampleEn: She is very mature for her age.
items.exampleZh: 以她的年紀來說，她非常成熟。

items.exampleEn: The passionate fans sang loudly for the whole match.
items.exampleZh: 熱情的球迷整場比賽都在大聲唱歌。

items.exampleEn: Her grandson is a charming boy who always says thank you.
items.exampleZh: 她的孫子是個討人喜歡的男孩，總是會說謝謝。

items.exampleEn: I hope you weren't offended by my question about your age.
items.exampleZh: 希望我問你年紀的事沒有冒犯到你。

items.sentenceEn: Speak of the devil! We were just talking about you.
items.sentenceZh: 說曹操，曹操就到！我們剛剛還在聊你呢。

items.audioEn: The new manager is passionate about helping young workers grow.
items.audioZh: 新經理很熱衷於幫助年輕員工成長。
options: Saving money for a new house

items.sentenceEn: It takes a mature person to admit a mistake.
items.sentenceZh: 能承認錯誤的人，才是成熟的人。

items.sentenceEn: Leaving the dinner early might offend the host.
items.sentenceZh: 提早離開晚宴可能會冒犯主人。

items.stemEn: The old village has ____ streets and friendly people, so tourists love it.
items.stemZh: 這座古老的村莊有迷人的街道和友善的居民，所以遊客很喜歡。

items.stemEn: The man's ____ helped the police find the stolen car.
items.stemZh: 那名男子的坦白，幫助警方找到了被偷的車。

items.passageEn: My favorite TV drama this year tells the story of two inseparable friends who open a small restaurant together. Lisa is passionate and full of ideas, while Ben is calm and mature. Their charming little restaurant becomes popular, but then Ben discovers that Lisa has been secretly planning to sell it. He feels completely betrayed. In a moving scene, Lisa makes a confession with tears in her eyes: she needed money to help her family. Ben, who has always shown compassion to others, decides to forgive her. My friends joke that Lisa is the bad guy of the story, but I think she is just human.
items.passageZh: 我今年最喜歡的電視劇，講的是兩個形影不離的好朋友一起開小餐廳的故事。Lisa 熱情、點子很多，Ben 則冷靜又成熟。他們那家迷人的小餐廳越來越受歡迎，但後來 Ben 發現 Lisa 一直偷偷計畫要把餐廳賣掉。他覺得自己完全被背叛了。在一場感人的戲裡，Lisa 含淚坦白：她需要錢來幫助家人。一向很有同情心的 Ben 決定原諒她。我朋友開玩笑說 Lisa 是這個故事裡的壞人，但我覺得她只是個普通人。

questions.questionZh: 兩個朋友一起開了什麼？
Ben 發現 Lisa 做了什麼？
options: 準備一個人偷偷搬到國外

items.promptZh: 我們應該對有困難的人有同情心。
referenceEn: We should show compassion to people in need.
We should have compassion for people who are having a hard time.
rubricZh: compassion 是不可數名詞（例如 show compassion to…、have compassion for…）
「有困難的人」可寫 people in need、people who are having a hard time 等

items.instructionZh: 用 betray 造一個句子，說說被背叛的感受，或你不願背叛別人的信任。
referenceEn: I would never betray my best friend's trust.
I felt betrayed when my colleague took credit for my work.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 betray（例如 betray someone's trust、feel betrayed）
